SELECT oiad.id, oiad.pull_date, oiad.put_away_date, oiad.inventory_qty, oiad.inventory_age FROM overseas_inventory_age_detail oiad INNER JOIN overseas_inventory oi ON oi.id = oiad.main_id AND oi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE oiad.is_deleted = FALSE
AND oiad.main_id = #{params.mainId}
AND oiad.inventory_age BETWEEN 0 AND 30
AND oiad.inventory_age BETWEEN 31 AND 60
AND oiad.inventory_age BETWEEN 61 AND 90
AND oiad.inventory_age BETWEEN 91 AND 180
AND oiad.inventory_age BETWEEN 181 AND 270
AND oiad.inventory_age BETWEEN 271 AND 365
AND oiad.inventory_age > 365
AND oiad.inventory_age = -1
order by oiad.inventory_age
